story.zh: 夺得汉中的曹操开始靠近益州边界寻找图取的机会，刘备听从众谋士的建议决定主动出击...
story.en: Having seized Hanzhong, Cao Cao draws near the borders of Yi Province in search of an opportunity to strike. Listening to the counsel of his advisors, Liu Bei resolves to take the initiative and attack...

trigger.zh: 刘备、张飞、诸葛亮、曹操存活。长安、汉中属曹操，成都属刘备。
trigger.en: Liu Bei, Zhang Fei, Zhuge Liang, and Cao Cao are alive. Changan and Hanzhong belong to Cao Cao, Chengdu belongs to Liu Bei.
